authority.parity_rule: whole LUT bytes and payload SHA-256 must match exactly

data_separation.media_payload_read_policy: read development during tuning and validation during selection only

baseline_and_ablation_contract.candidate_rule: every full-ASH candidate must carry uniform comparison identities selected for the exact same shared-bank hash
baseline_and_ablation_contract.final_rule: freeze only the finally selected bank's control identities in locked-quality-policy.json before P07

corpus_lock_bundle_contract.canonicalization: sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON with no trailing newline
corpus_lock_bundle_contract.media_policy: hash only already-open metadata files; never resolve or open a media payload
corpus_lock_bundle_contract.compiler_binding: corpus_lock_bundle_sha256 is the SHA-256 of that canonical object and is not the general calibration input bundle hash

spatial_temporal_threshold_policy.future_temporal_phase: P10 creates a new mapping version and calibrates temporal thresholds without changing P07 spatial semantics

cell_geometry.origin: origin_x = cell_x * s and origin_y = cell_y * s
cell_geometry.actual_extent: actual_width = min(s, source_width - origin_x) and actual_height = min(s, source_height - origin_y)
cell_geometry.cell_count: cell_count_x = ceil(source_width / s), cell_count_y = ceil(source_height / s), total = cell_count_x * cell_count_y
cell_geometry.integer_count_formula: cell_count_x = (source_width + s - 1) / s and cell_count_y = (source_height + s - 1) / s using integer division

feature_analysis.sampling: sample every integer-offset tap of the locked Scharr, tensor, texture, and risk stencils bilinearly at center plus tap offset
feature_analysis.boundary: resolve each bilinear integer source tap with the selected locked boundary mode before weighted combination
feature_analysis.step_one_reduction: for s = 1 every center is an integer source site and bilinear fractions are zero, yielding exactly the P05 integer-site feature math
feature_analysis.cell_output: one packed state and one continuous sidecar are computed per cell and remain constant for every target sample assigned to that cell

dispatch_assignment.coordinate_input: use the exact continuous target-to-source coordinate expressed in luma source-lattice coordinates
dispatch_assignment.state_and_sidecar: select the cell-constant packed state and sidecar without interpolation
dispatch_assignment.target_phase: derive and retain the exact route target phase from the unrounded exact source coordinate; cell assignment never changes phase

chroma_siting.analysis: map each continuous luma cell center through the locked exact chroma-siting correction before bilinear Cb and Cr sampling
chroma_siting.dispatch: convert the exact chroma source coordinate through the locked siting correction into luma source-lattice coordinates before cell assignment
chroma_siting.rounding: perform no intermediate rounding; retain exact rational siting and route phase semantics until the declared cell-index floor

search.candidate_order: the parameter_order list below; each candidate vector is visited in ascending serialized integer or listed categorical order
search.initial_vector: use initial_vector_values exactly; every value is a declared candidate and no runtime or corpus observation may alter initialization
search.sweep_rule: visit every parameter exactly once per sweep; retain the best feasible value for that coordinate before advancing
search.termination: stop after a complete sweep changes no coordinate
search.tie_break: objective tuple, then lexicographically smallest complete serialized candidate vector
search.record_rule: append every attempted candidate, including failures, to an immutable run ledger

objective.comparison_domain_rule: engine_raw and container_decoded are computed and gated separately; both must be feasible, while the declared search and selection tuples use engine_raw values and never aggregate the two domains
feasibility_first: all fixed quality and numeric tolerances pass
all operator distinctness and state causality checks pass
each route-specific analysis-grid choice passes its route quality and occupancy checks
estimated candidate count is at most two
estimated performance satisfies every preregistered blocking floor
development_tuple: descending mean Y PSNR delta versus best fixed same-bank operator
descending mean Y PSNR delta versus non-ASH same-bank selector
descending MS-SSIM delta versus best conventional baseline
objective.validation_selection: select only among development-feasible terminal vectors and their one-coordinate neighbors
validation_tuple: descending lower 95-percent paired-bootstrap bound for Y PSNR versus best fixed same-bank operator
descending lower 95-percent paired-bootstrap bound for Y PSNR versus non-ASH same-bank selector
descending lower 95-percent paired-bootstrap bound for Y PSNR versus best conventional baseline
objective.pareto_rule: discard a vector only when another feasible vector is no worse in every listed quality and cost dimension and strictly better in at least one; apply the tuple only to the remaining frontier

fixed_choices.temporal_payload_semantics: clear coordinate 7 for semantic decisions and recompute coordinate 9 parity
fixed_choices.temporal_context_semantics: compile contexts 1 through 3 as spatial context aliases

p00_compatibility_legal_range_normalizat.scope: reopened P00 helper NV12 output before PlanarFrame conversion, control-output caching, engine-raw metrics, and container encoding
p00_compatibility_legal_range_normalizat.evidence: bind raw and normalized payload SHA-256 values and sizes, raw and normalized per-plane code ranges, and exact six-direction clip counts in every P00 native control record
p00_compatibility_legal_range_normalizat.direct_2x_postprocess_behavior: unchanged exact 2x; compatibility normalization only clips nominal-range excursions
p00_compatibility_legal_range_normalizat.uniform_application: apply identically to every P00 control invocation before any comparison domain is derived

container_decoded_legal_range_normalizat.scope: reopened isolated production HEVC writer 420v bytes before PlanarFrame conversion and container-decoded metrics only
container_decoded_legal_range_normalizat.evidence: bind raw and normalized payload SHA-256 values and sizes, raw and normalized per-plane code ranges, and exact six-direction clip counts
container_decoded_legal_range_normalizat.uniform_application: apply identically to every candidate, baseline, fixed operator, and ablation container-decoded output
